proposition_text: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at standard sea-level atmospheric pressure.
Solid iron floats effortlessly on top of pure liquid water at room temperature.
If all mammals are warm-blooded and whales are mammals, then whales are warm-blooded.
A triangle on a flat Euclidean plane can contain two interior angles of 100 degrees each.
An urn contains 52 red balls and 48 blue balls; a single blind draw will yield a red ball.
A fair coin flipped three times in a row will land on heads more often than tails.
Sub-glacial liquid water oceans on Europa currently harbor chemosynthetic microbial life.
A newly synthesized nootropic compound with 62% Phase-II response rate will pass Phase-III trials.
